typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		{} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'DECLARE @MARKET VARCHAR(100) DECLARE @MARKET1 VARCHAR(100) DECLARE @MARKET2 VARCHAR(100)  SET @MARKET = SUBSTRING( CAST(? AS VARCHAR) ,1, CHARINDEX(\'|\',CAST(? AS VARCHAR))-1)  IF(CHARINDEX(\',\',@MARKET)!=0) 	BEGIN 		SET @MARKET1 = SUBSTRING( @MARKET ,1, CHARINDEX(\',\',@MARKET)-1)  		SET @MARKET2 = SUBSTRING( @MARKET ,CHARINDEX(\',\',REVERSE(@MARKET))+1, CHARINDEX(\',\',REVERSE(@MARKET))-1)  	END ELSE 	BEGIN 		SET @MARKET1 = @MARKET 		SET @MARKET2 = \'\'     END  SELECT MARKET       ,[segment_identifier]       ,[lab_record_identifier]       ,[Member_ID]       ,[lab_providr_entity_name]       ,[lab_test_dos]       ,[loinc_code]       ,[lab_test_results_text]       ,[results_units_name_01]        ,[Ordering_provider]       ,[Abnormal_Flags]       ,[Lab_Value_Range_Minimum]       ,[Lab_Value_Range_Maximum]    FROM [DATA_EXCHANGE].[EXTRACT].[POMELO_LAB_CLAIMS_EXTRACT]     WHERE Market = @MARKET1    UNION    SELECT MARKET       ,[segment_identifier]       ,[lab_record_identifier]       ,[Member_ID]       ,[lab_providr_entity_name]       ,[lab_test_dos]       ,[loinc_code]       ,[lab_test_results_text]       ,[results_units_name_01]        ,[Ordering_provider]       ,[Abnormal_Flags]       ,[Lab_Value_Range_Minimum]       ,[Lab_Value_Range_Maximum]    FROM [DATA_EXCHANGE].[EXTRACT].[POMELO_LAB_CLAIMS_EXTRACT]     WHERE Market = @MARKET2    ORDER BY [Member_ID],[segment_identifier],[lab_test_dos]',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> SourceTablePOMELOLABCLAIMSEXTRACT
SourceTablePOMELOLABCLAIMSEXTRACT sink(input(
		Lab_Value_Range_Minimum as string,
		Lab_Record_Identifier as string,
		Member_Identifier as string,
		Lab_Test_DOS as string,
		Lab_Test_Results_Text as string,
		Segment_Identifier as string,
		Lab_Provider_Entity_Name as string,
		Abnormal_Flags as string,
		Loinc_Code as string,
		Lab_Value_Range_Maximum as string,
		Ordering_Provider as string,
		Results_Units_Name_01 as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Lab_Value_Range_Minimum,
		Lab_Record_Identifier = lab_record_identifier,
		Member_Identifier = Member_ID,
		Lab_Test_DOS = lab_test_dos,
		Lab_Test_Results_Text = lab_test_results_text,
		Segment_Identifier = segment_identifier,
		Lab_Provider_Entity_Name = lab_providr_entity_name,
		Abnormal_Flags,
		Loinc_Code = loinc_code,
		Lab_Value_Range_Maximum,
		Ordering_Provider = Ordering_provider,
		Results_Units_Name_01 = results_units_name_01)) ~> FlatFileLabClaimsKY
